words.definition: websites and apps where people share information and talk to others
words.example: Many young people use social media every day.

words.definition: to put a message, photo or video on the internet for others to see
words.example: She posted a photo of her dog.

words.definition: to send something you found online to other people
words.example: He shared the article with his friends.

words.definition: a short written opinion about something online
words.example: I left a comment under her photo.

words.definition: to click a button to show you enjoy a post
words.example: I liked her new profile picture.

words.definition: to choose to see someone's posts regularly online
words.example: I follow my favorite singer on social media.

words.definition: a person you know well and like
words.example: She has many friends online and in real life.

words.definition: to talk with someone in a friendly, informal way, often online
words.example: We chatted for an hour last night.

words.definition: to speak to someone using a phone
words.example: I called my mother after work.

words.definition: to send a written message using a phone
words.example: Can you text me your address?

words.definition: a picture taken with a camera
words.example: He posted a photo from his trip.

words.definition: information about you on a social media account
words.example: My profile has my name and photo.

words.definition: a group of connected people or computers
words.example: Social media helps you build a network of friends.

words.definition: to add new information
words.example: I updated my profile with a new photo.

words.definition: to add someone's name to a photo or post online
words.example: She tagged me in her holiday photo.

words.definition: a message that tells you something new has happened
words.example: I got a notification about her new post.

words.definition: a number of people who are connected together
words.example: We made a family group to share news.

words.definition: a person you can communicate with, often saved in your phone
words.example: She is one of my contacts on my phone.

words.definition: a talk between two or more people
words.example: We had a long conversation about our holiday.

words.definition: to share information or ideas with someone
words.example: Social media helps people communicate with family far away.

text: Social media has changed the way people communicate. Ten years ago, if you wanted to talk to a friend, you usually called them or waited to see them. Today, you can text, chat, or start a video call in seconds. Many people use social media to stay in touch with their network of friends and family. For example, when Maria goes on holiday, she takes a lot of photos and posts them online for her friends to see. Her friends often leave a comment or like her post. Sometimes, they tag her in a photo too. Maria also joined a group for people who love cooking. In the group, people share recipes and have interesting conversations. Every day, Maria gets many notifications on her phone about new posts from her contacts. She checks her profile and updates it with new information sometimes. Communication is much faster now than before, but some people think we should also call our friends and family, not just follow them online. Real conversations are still very important.
